notes.title: The bullet-hell pet-capturing game "Protean Fox" will beta test
notes.content:
Our independently developed bullet-hell shooting game, "Protean Fox" , is about to commence a small-scale beta test!

Eager to experience a light-hearted, fun-filled, and surprise-packed adventure? This is a bullet-hell shooting game that combines relaxed shooting, adorable pet collection, and exploration of multi-style maps. You will transform into a mystical fox, embarking on an adventure in a fantastical world!

Game Introduction:

"Protean Fox" is a bullet-hell shooting game that offers both ease and challenge. In the game, players will take on the role of a charming spirit fox, using firearms, immortal tools, and magic to battle various monsters across worlds with distinct styles, befriend more pet companions, and seek the lost flames of the spirit fox!

The little spirit fox will wield weapons from different worlds, traverse between three uniquely styled maps, and capture pet companions from each map! The game focuses on the design of weapons and items, along with a special pet-catching gameplay. The official version will bring players over 300 creative items, more than 100 weapons, nearly 100 unique off-hand items, over 120 pets plus several hidden ones, and 3x5=15 levels of maps with different style fusions, original special gameplay, and 15 different school skins for the main character~

This test will open part of the levels in three major areas, along with most of the "immortal tools" weapons and over 60 unique pets. Everyone is welcome to join the little spirit fox on its wondrous journey!

Beta Test Recruitment Details:

● Test Period: March 18, 2025 - March 28, 2025

● Test Platform: Steam

● Number of Recruits: Unlimited

● Registration Method: Follow our QQ group: 645822693. Updates and announcements will be posted on the day the test begins, and activation codes will be distributed! We will also draw various small game rewards for players who participate in the test and provide feedback!
